scope: AgentCapsule downstream writable-volume lifetime locking. Not an upstream release binary.
limitations: Advisory flock: all writers must use this build or the same locking protocol
Regular file inode aliases are covered; multiple block-device nodes/mappings to the same underlying sectors are not covered
AArch64 policy updated but not built/tested on this x86_64 host
Live drive replacement with another open of the same locked inode is rejected; runtime uses cold starts and no drive hot-swap
